nl.bodyHtml:

Voorbereiding

  • Toegang tot betaaldashboard (Mollie/Stripe) + shop-admin
  • Focus van dit artikel: foutmelding, betaling, mislukt
  • Notitie van de huidige instelling/status

Stappen

  1. Log in op betaaldashboard (Mollie/Stripe) + shop-admin. Filter of zoek op onderdelen die horen bij foutmelding, betaling, mislukt.
  2. Zet de plugin/app eerst in testmodus met testkeys voor foutmelding.
  3. Configureer webhook-URL + secret; valideer handtekeningen.
  4. Doe een testbetaling die betaling raakt; check orderstatus.
  5. Schakel live pas na succes; herhaal een kleine smoke-test.
  6. Isoleer: werkt het elders wél (ander netwerk, webmail vs client, staging vs live) voor foutmelding, betaling, mislukt?
  7. Koppel aan de laatste wijziging; rol terug of fix één oorzaak tegelijk.

  • Externe test of tweede browser/netwerk bevestigt het resultaat

Tip: Werk in kleine stappen: eerst foutmelding, betaling, mislukt goed krijgen, daarna pas optionele extras.

en.bodyHtml:
For Error message 'payment failed': diagnosis follow a targeted checklist in the payment dashboard (Mollie/Stripe) + shop admin. Core themes: error, message, payment.

Preparation

  • Access to the payment dashboard (Mollie/Stripe) + shop admin
  • Focus of this article: error, message, payment
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Sign in to the payment dashboard (Mollie/Stripe) + shop admin. Filter or search for parts that belong to error, message, payment.
  2. Put the plugin/app in test mode with test keys for error first.
  3. Configure webhook URL + secret; validate signatures.
  4. Run a test payment that hits message; check order status.
  5. Go live only after success; repeat a small smoke test.
  6. Isolate: does it work elsewhere (other network, webmail vs client, staging vs live) for error, message, payment?
  7. Correlate with the last change; roll back or fix one cause at a time.

Verify

  • Result for error, message, payment matches “Error message 'payment failed': diagnosis”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside error message payment
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get error, message, payment right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if error, message, payment touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: the payment dashboard (Mollie/Stripe) + shop admin, backups, tickets.
